summary: NexPoint Capital, a Delaware-incorporated business development company, filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that as of September 22, 2026, its net asset value per share and distribution reinvestment plan (DRP) issuance price were determined to be $4.64 per share. The valuation was set under the adviser's Rule 2a-5 policies approved by the board, with the adviser retaining sole discretion to set the DRP price at not less than NAV. No transaction, stake, premium, advisor, or structural event is present; this is an ordinary NAV/DRP pricing disclosure.
